name: private-decl-same-module
desc: use of a private declaration in the same module
code: private const x: u32 = 3; const y = x; public const z = x; fn foo() { let w = x; }
result: const x: u32 = 3; const y = x; const z = x; fn foo() { let w = x; }

name: import-private-decl
desc: cannot import a private declaration from a different module

name: reverse-import-private-decl
desc: another module cannot import a private direction in the current module

name: import-private-decl-inline
desc: cannot inline-import a private declaration from a different module

name: cross-package-import-public-decl
desc: import a public declaration from a different package
result: const foo_m1_x: u32 = 3; const y = foo_m1_x;

name: cross-package-import-public-decl-inline
desc: inline-import a public declaration from a different package
result: const foo_m1_x: u32 = 3; const y = foo_m1_x;

name: cross-package-import-package-decl
desc: cannot import a package-visible declaration from a different package

name: cross-package-import-package-decl-inline
desc: cannot import a package-visible declaration from a different package

name: cross-package-import-private-decl
desc: cannot import a private declaration from a different package

name: cross-package-import-private-decl-inline
desc: cannot import a private declaration from a different package

name: public-import-public-decl
result: const package_m2_x: u32 = 3; const y = package_m2_x;

name: public-import-package-decl
desc: cannot public-import a package-visible declaration (widens visibility)

name: package-import-package-decl
result: const package_m2_x: u32 = 3; const y = package_m2_x;

name: cross-package-public-import-public-decl
desc: use a public import of public declaration from a different package
result: const foo_m2_x: u32 = 3; const y = foo_m2_x;

name: cross-package-package-import-public-decl
desc: cannot use a non-public import of public declaration from a different package

name: chained-visibility-narrowing
desc: two imports narrow the original visibility of a declaration
code: private import package::m1::x; const y = x;
result: const package_m3_x: u32 = 3; const y = package_m3_x;

name: circular-visibility-requirements
desc: private import of a declaration that depends on the current module
code: private import package::m1::x; const y: u32 = 3; const z = x;
result: const package_m1_x = y; const y: u32 = 3; const z = package_m1_x;
